g.text: The units differ: ours in share of switches, Zach's in points. Read the sign and the order, not the size.
Grey tick: the same operation with a random part of the same size instead (for his stored rows, his rotated
lens directions), recall minus lookup; every mark is already net of it except his stored rows.
Muse's rung 6 ran at L23–29; his band is L36–42, where it was not run. K items: on his passages the lookup is
his K final, the answer stated in the passage; the rerun on his P items is pending.
The two operations differ in scope: one token at one layer vs every token over a band.
Omitted: 27B under Zach's operation on our scenes, not run; Muse on his passages, too few lookup switches (25
of 200). The last rung: two separate estimates, no joint interval.
control: a random part (same size); his: rotated directions
